text:
sam: quick check — can someone run a pairwise microbench comparing L40S vs H100 for small-batch QPS? seeing p99 spikes on L40S for longctx runs and want to confirm it's hw vs config
bench-bot: queued a job on the nightly pool, id 20260317-007. i can also run on dedicated if needed :robot_face:
anya: what's the exact workload? model, seq len, batch sizes?
sam: model=redwood/rlm-13b, seq=1024, batch in [1,2,4], kv cache warm, tokens gen cap=512, collect p50/p95/p99 + gpu_util + power
michael: do we need to pin driver version? last L40S run used 535.86, H100 had 540.30. could explain perf diff
jordan: also check nvlink topology — are L40S hosts single-socket? memory placement can matter for kv cache pressure
ai bench-bot: bench job started on h100-rt-04 and l40s-rt-02 in parallel. ETA ~18m. will post raw csv when done
kai: fyi run this invoker to reproduce locally:```./run_bench.sh --model rlm-13b --seq 1024 --batch 1,2,4 --kv-warm --gen 512 --collect-metrics csv,prom``` change provider via `--host h100-rt-04`
bench-bot: h100 results: batch=1 p50=12.3ms p95=45.7ms p99=82.2ms qps=68
bench-bot: l40s results: batch=1 p50=13.0ms p95=52.9ms p99=135.6ms qps=63
bench-bot: summary: L40S p99 much higher for batch=1, gating at ~512 gen steps. cpu-side stalls visible in perf trace. attaching short flame snippet
bench-bot: attachment: /artifacts/20260317-007/flame-l40s-smallbatch.txt
anya: can you share the perf counters? mem_bw, l2 misses, sm active?
bench-bot: perf snapshot (abridged): l40s: dram_bw=180GB/s l2_miss=4.2% sm_util=72% h100: dram_bw=210GB/s l2_miss=2.1% sm_util=68%
michael: that dram_bw gap is notable. L40S host might have PCIe fallback or thermal throttle under long runs. can we confirm power/thermal logs?
sam: thanks — useful. action items: (1) eng-runtime to re-run on L40S with driver 540.30 (michael), (2) infra to verify nvlink/topology & power caps (jordan), (3) bench to add microtrace capture for next run (bench-bot). ping me when done and we can decide fallback policy for small-batch low-latency routes
jordan: noted, i'll check topology and power cap. will also try adjusting `--kv-prefetch=on` to see impact
kai: quick note — if we see consistent p99 divergence we should add a model-variant fallback to h100 for latency-critical routes in routing rules
sam: agreed. i'll open a follow-up PR to add the routing override after we confirm. thanks all :thumbsup:
